<action type="say">
First, go shut off the water to stop the damage:

1) Look under your kitchen sink for two small valves (usually on the back wall): one for hot (often left) and one for cold (right).  
2) Turn both valves clockwise until they stop. If there are no under-sink valves, you may need to shut off the main water supply (usually in the garage, near the street, or where the water line enters the house) by turning the main valve clockwise.

Once you’ve shut the water off and the leak has slowed/stopped, reply “done” and I’ll line up a licensed, insured emergency plumber near 1234 Main Street, Fort Worth, within the next few hours and walk you through confirming the booking.</action>
